title: Add showPicker to <select> elements
body: Closes #7957 and #9757 ### Mini-explainer for TAG review / blink-dev purposes: The showPicker() method is a new addition to HTMLSelectElement which addresses a [common request from web developers](https://www.google.com/search?q=programmatically+open+select+site%3Astackoverflow.com): programmatically showing the option picker UI for a select element ```html ``` In today's browsers there's currently no way to programatically open a select element. This spec adds a new method to a select element to make that possible, following in the footsteps of the `showPicker()` method added to HTMLInputElement. showPicker() is specified with a few restrictions to improve security: It can only be called with transient user activation. If called without, it will throw a "NotAllowedError" DOMException. (This is the same as how it behaves on inputs.) It can only be called in same-origin iframes. If called in a cross-origin iframe, it will throw a "SecurityError" DOMException. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Gecko * Chromium (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9754#issuecomment-1747137961) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/42091 - tests user gesture, mutability and same-origin requirements. * Actually showing the picker is not testable in WPT - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1485010 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1854112 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=261814 - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: * https://github.com/mdn/browser-compat-data/pull/20852 MDN Browser Compat Data PR * https://github.com/mdn/content/pull/29406 MDN Content PR - Standards Positions: - Gecko: https://github.com/mozilla/standards-positions/issues/886 - WebKit: https://github.com/WebKit/standards-positions/issues/258 - Chromium: https://chromestatus.com/feature/5111537299881984 (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** /acknowledgements.html ( diff ) /form-elements.html ( diff ) /input.html ( diff )
